summary: The figure shows the age-standardized prevalence of hypertension among adults aged 30–79 years across WHO regions and globally from 1990 to 2019. The European Region shows a marked decline in prevalence over time, while the South-East Asia and Western Pacific regions show an increasing trend. The African Region and Eastern Mediterranean Region have relatively stable or slightly decreasing trends. Globally, prevalence peaked around 2010 and declined slightly by 2019.
